title: BizFlood Renewal, Expiry and Non-Renewal
content:
For BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines), the renewal offer is issued the tier's renewal offer period in calendar days before term end. When the tier requires a signed statement of values to renew, the renewal is bound only on a statement of values signed within the renewal offer period and payment under the elected plan by term end; otherwise the policy expires at term end with no grace period. Tidemark may non-renew only by written notice mailed the tier's non-renewal notice period in calendar days before term end.

A term that ends without a renewal being bound ends the policy as expired at term end. A renewal that is bound starts a renewed term on an updated statement of values and payment, with the locations, total insured value and premium of the renewed term.

## The renewal decision

| Statement of values signed within the renewal offer period | Payment under the elected plan received by term end | Outcome at term end |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The renewal is bound |
| Yes | No | Not bound; the policy expires at term end, with no grace period |
| No | Yes | Not bound; the policy expires at term end, with no grace period |
| No | No | Not bound; the policy expires at term end, with no grace period |

This table applies where the tier requires a signed statement of values to renew.

## Timeline illustration (hypothetical dates and a hypothetical 60-day offer period)

For a term ending on 30 June:

- The renewal offer is issued 60 calendar days before term end, on 1 May.
- A statement of values signed on 20 May, within the renewal offer period, and payment received on 30 June, the term end itself, meet the conditions: payment "by term end" includes the term end date.
- The same statement with payment received on 1 July does not meet the conditions; there is no grace period, and the policy expires at term end on 30 June.

## Non-renewal by Tidemark

Tidemark's non-renewal is valid only by written notice mailed the tier's non-renewal notice period in calendar days before term end. For a hypothetical term ending on 30 June and a hypothetical 90-day notice period, that is a notice mailed on 1 April.
